# USGBC Support Center

> > Official support and help center for LEED certification, green building credentials, Arc performance platform, and GBCI sustainability programs.

This is the U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC) and Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI) support portal providing documentation, training resources, and account management for LEED-certified projects, professional credentials (LEED AP, LEED Green Associate), and complementary programs including SITES, PEER, TRUE, and Arc performance monitoring.

## Key Topics

- LEED certification
- LEED AP with specialty
- LEED Green Associate
- Green building certification
- Arc performance platform
- GBCI programs (SITES, PEER, TRUE)
- LEED for Cities and Communities
- LEED for Neighborhood Development
- USGBC membership
- Professional credentials
- Continuing education
- Sustainability rating systems
- Building performance
- Green building education
- Project certification process

## LEED Certification

- [What is LEED certification?](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/articles/4404406912403-What-is-LEED-certification): Overview of LEED green building certification and rating system
- [USGBC Support Home](https://support.usgbc.org/): USGBC/GBCI help center for LEED certification and Arc support

## GBCI Sustainability Programs

- [GBCI Programs](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/gbci-programs): GBCI programs: SITES, PEER, TRUE zero waste certifications

## Education & Training

- [Education](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/education): LEED training courses and green building education catalog

## Account & Billing Support

- [Billing](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/billing): Billing info for LEED certification, credentials, and membership fees
- [Membership](https://support.usgbc.org/hc/en-us/p/membership): USGBC membership benefits and account management info
